lines.japanese:
……ダメだ、そんな気分じゃない。
　気を遣ってくれた琥珀さんには悪いけど、弓塚との事が忘れられないうちは、とてもじゃないけどそんな気分にはなれない。
　この二日間。
　あんなに他人の血を見てきた自分が、琥珀さんや秋葉、翡翠に歓迎されていいはずが、ない。
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish:
No. I couldn’t celebrate. I felt bad after Kohaku had gone out of her way for me, but until I could forget what had happened with Yumizuka, I couldn’t possibly be in the mood.
These past two days, I had seen so much of other people’s blood. Someone like me had no right to be welcomed by Kohaku, Akiha, and Hisui.

These past two days.
After I've seen so much of other people's blood, I can't be welcomed by them.

「あ――――れ」
―――どくん。
　唐突に。
―――ドクン。
　眩暈が、して。

Thump.
“What…?”
thump.
All at once,
Thump.
the room began to spin.

lines.japanese:
「ちょっと、兄さん―――！」
　……秋葉の声が聞こえる。
　だがそれで薄れていく意識が止まってくれるワケでもない。
「しっかりしてください、兄さん……！」
　秋葉の声が遠くなっていく。
　……まったく、自分でもイヤになる。
　ただ弓塚との事を思い出しただけで、遠野志貴は意識を失おうとしてしまっているんだから――――
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish: “Brother!” I heard Akiha call out, but her voice couldn’t arrest the darkness swallowing my mind. “Stay with me, Brother…!” Her voice receded into the distance. God, I disgusted myself. Merely remembering Yumizuka was enough to make Shiki Tohno lose consciousness.

"Hang in there, Nii-san……!"

…… Sheesh, I really am pretty pathetic.
Just thinking about Yumizuka and what happened, I lose consciousness like this----

lines.japanese:
―――――なんて偽善だろう。
　俺は、俺自身がゆめに見るゆめの中で、そんな都合のいい言葉をゆめみている。
　忘れられるのなら、それはとても楽なことだ。
　けど忘れられない。
　好きでもなければ嫌いでもなかったけど、
　彼女の笑顔を忘れてはいけない気がする。
　それになにより。
　この首筋の傷痕が痛むかぎり、忘れる事などできないんだから――――
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish:
—What nauseating hypocrisy.
Inside the dream I dream for myself, I dream up the words that suit me best.
If I could forget, everything would be so much easier. But I couldn’t. I had neither loved nor hated her, yet I felt that I must never forget her smile. More than anything, as long as the scar on my throat continued to ache, forgetting would be impossible.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
-----Isn't that just a false happiness?
In a dream I dreamed about, I dreamt those selfish words.
If I can just forget, it will be very easy for me.
But I can't forget.
I neither liked her nor hated her, but,
I think I shouldn't forget her smile.
And more than that,
as long as this scar remains on my neck, I can't forget----

「あ―――――」
　気がつくと、自分の部屋で横になっていた。
　俺はベッドに眠っていて、目の前には秋葉の姿がある。
「秋、葉？」
「気がついた？
　もう、なんだっていきなり貧血なんておこすんですか、兄さんは」
「そうか……やっぱり倒れたのか、俺」
「はい。
あれから七時間も眠っていたんですよ、兄さんは」
「―――そうか。
最近なにかと寝不足だったから、その反動かもしれないな」
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah…” When I came to, I was lying in my own room. I was in bed, and Akiha was sitting before me.
“Aki…ha?”
“You’re awake? Honestly, why must you suddenly collapse from anemia like that?” “I see… So I did pass out.”
“Yes. You slept for seven hours.” “I see. I haven’t been sleeping much lately. Perhaps it all caught up with me.”

「……秋葉？」
「はい？

「―――その、さ。

「それは私は邪魔、という事ですか？」
「いや、そういうわけじゃなくて、秋葉は退屈じゃないかなって」
「退屈ですが、我慢はできます。
好きでしている事だから、兄さんが気に病む必要はありません」
「………………む」
　それなら―――まあ、いいけど。
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Akiha?”
“Yes? What is it?” “Well… You must be bored sitting there. I’m fine now, so you can go back to your room.”
“Are you telling me I’m in the way?” “No, nothing like that. I only thought you might be bored.”
“I am bored, but I can endure it. I’m here because I choose to be, so you needn’t feel guilty.” “……Mm.” In that case, I supposed it was all right.

時間が流れる。
　時刻は夜の七時を過ぎていた。
　あれから七時間。
秋葉はこうして俺の看病をしてくれてたんだろうか。
　秋葉は黙って、俺の熱を測っている。
　……ああ、思い出した。
　あれはたしか、もう八年以上前のことだ。
　風邪かなにかをこじらせた自分のところに、秋葉が見舞いにきたことがあったっけ。

Time passed. It was already after seven in the evening. Had Akiha truly spent all seven hours nursing me like this? Without a word, she checked my temperature.
Then I remembered. It had been more than eight years ago. Once, when I had been terribly ill with a cold, Akiha had come to visit me.

lines.maoEnglish: It had been a vicious cold, so bad that every breath hurt. A black-haired girl had sat at my bedside, holding my hand. Tatami and paper screens. The cold hush of winter. Little akiha in the dark room, watching me as though she might cry.

「……すこし、安心した」
「え？
　なにか言った、兄さん？」
「……ああ。
秋葉にも少しは昔の面影が残ってるんだなって思ってさ。
なんでもないことなのに、なんだか嬉しくなったんだ」
　本当に自然に、自分でも驚くぐらい優しく、秋葉に微笑む。
「それはいいですけど、兄さんは昔とまったく変わりませんね。
人に手間隙をかけさせるところぐらい、少しは正してください」
　顔を背けて憎まれ口をたたく秋葉。
　今は、それが照れ隠しだっていうことがわかってしまって、余計に嬉しくなってしまった。
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish:
“…That’s a relief.”
“What? Did you say something?” “Yes. I was thinking that there’s still a little of the old Akiha left in you. It’s nothing important, but realizing it made me happy.” Without effort or artifice, I smiled at her so gently that I surprised myself.
“That’s very nice, but you haven’t changed at all. You might at least correct this habit of making everyone fuss over you.” Akiha turned away and delivered the insult. Now that I understood she was only hiding her embarrassment, it made me happier still.

“Good morning, Tohno. Fancy meeting you at the entrance.” “I saw you ahead of me and ran to catch up. Do you always arrive around this time?”
“Yes. I’m terrible at waking early, so I’m always cutting it close. Did you oversleep this morning?”

lines.maoEnglish:
Thud—clatter, crash, bang.
“……” Unbelievable. As if delivering a flying Rider Kick weren’t enough, the idiot had carried us through the collision and rolled us across the ground three full times. “……” I stood and brushed the dirt from my clothes.
Arihiko rose too and slapped the dust from his uniform.

"………………"
I get up and shake off all the dust from my clothes.
Arihiko also stands up and pats his uniform.

lines.mao_english: “Tohno! Are you all right, Tohno?” The voice from the front of the room snapped me awake. Sweat drenched my forehead. My body had gone cold, while my breath came in harsh, ragged gasps.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun!
Hey, are you alright, Tohno-kun!?"
My eyes open wide at the sound of the teacher's voice.
…… Sweat rolls down my forehead.
My body is cold, my breathing is ragged.

lines.japanese:
「どうしたんだ遠野くん。
きみ、体の調子が悪いなら休んでいいぞ」
「あ、いえ。
大丈夫です、おさまりましたから」
「……そうか。
まあ、あまり無茶はしないようにね。
きみの場合、成績はいいんだから少しは休んでもいいんだぞ。
多少のハンデがあっても問題はないだろうからね」
　……英語の教師の言い分は、少しデリカシーにかけると思う。
　大丈夫です、とはっきり断言して、授業を再開させた。
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish: “What happened, Tohno? If you’re unwell, you may go rest.” “No, sir. I’m all right. It has passed.” “I see. Don’t push yourself too hard. Your grades are excellent, so you can afford to miss a little class. Even with your condition, you shouldn’t have trouble keeping up.” The English teacher’s concern lacked a certain tact. I insisted that I was fine, and class resumed.

I once again declare I am fine and resume class.

昼休みになって、教室中があわただしくなる。
「――――はあ」
　ため息がもれる。
　朝から熱っぽかったけど、本当に風邪でも引いているのか、全身がだるかった。
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish: At lunchtime the classroom erupted into motion. “Haaah…” A sigh escaped me. I had felt feverish since morning, and now my whole body was heavy. Perhaps I truly had caught a cold.

*sigh*

I've been hot since this morning.
Maybe I caught a cold.
My whole body feels languid.

「……ああ、今日はちょっと体調が悪くてさ。
学食まで行けないから、買い物頼まれてくれないか？
　購買のいつものセットでいいから」
「いや、それはかまわないけどな。
いいのか、おまえの妹さん、なんだか食堂で困ってた風だったぞ」
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish: “What’s this, Tohno? Still in the classroom?” “Yeah. I’m not feeling well today. I can’t make it to the cafeteria, so could you buy lunch for me? My usual set from the school store is fine.” “Sure, but what about your sister? She looked rather lost in the cafeteria.”

lines.japanese:
「――――あ」
　そうか、あいつは今までお嬢さま学校に通っていたから、一般の学校の『学食』っていうシステムをまったく知らないんだ。
　今ごろ学食に行って、立ち往生している秋葉の姿がありありと目に浮かぶ。
―――くそ、そんなの放っておける訳がない。
「あ、遠野！
　行くならオレも行くぞ！」
　教室を駆け出る。
　……後ろからは、妙にハッスルした有彦が付いてきた。
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah.” Of course. She had always attended a refined young ladies’ academy. She wouldn’t know the first thing about an ordinary school cafeteria. I could picture her perfectly, stranded in the middle of it with no idea what to do.
Damn it. I couldn’t leave her like that.
“Hey, Tohno! If you’re going, I’m coming too!” I bolted from the classroom. Behind me came an inexplicably enthusiastic Arihiko.

“Hey, Tohno! If you’re going, I’m coming too!” I bolted from the classroom. Behind me came an inexplicably enthusiastic Arihiko.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----Ah."
That's right.

----Damn, I can't leave her like that.
"Ah, Tohno!
Wait up!
I'm coming too!"
I dash out of the classroom.
…… Close behind me, Arihiko follows a bit more energetic than usual.

「―――ったく。
なにしてるんだ、あいつは」
　急いで秋葉のところに走りよる。
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish: Akiha stood frozen in the center of the crowded cafeteria, alone and plainly unable to decide what she was meant to do. “Honestly, what is she doing?” I hurried toward her.

「秋葉」
「兄、さん」
　一瞬。
　秋葉の顔が泣きそうなものに見えて、胸が痛んだ。
「―――ほら、こっちにこい。
おまえ、こういう人込みは嫌いだろ」
「あ――――はい」
　もう、一秒だってそんな泣きそうな顔なんか見たくなくて、強引に秋葉の腕をとって食堂を後にした。
lines.label: s303
lines.maoEnglish:
“Akiha.”
“Bro…ther.” For one instant, Akiha looked ready to cry, and pain tightened my chest. “Come on. This way. You hate crowds like this, don’t you?” “Ah… yes.”
I couldn’t bear that near-tearful face for even another second. I seized Akiha by the arm and pulled her out of the cafeteria.

"----C'mon, over here.

"Ah----yes."
Not wanting to see her almost crying face a second longer, I strongly pull Akiha out of the cafeteria.

Refusing to be outdone, Arihiko joined the secret council. “Sure, but you can’t throw us together alone right away. Ordinarily I’d prefer it that way, but your sister is much too advanced for a beginner.”

Arihiko sprinted back toward the school building.

“Ow—” Another pulse of pain. Not my head or chest—the side of my neck. “…That’s strange. My neck’s never hurt like this before.” I touch it, but there is no blood. The wound where Yumizuka bit me closed long ago.

「おはようございます、志貴さま」
「あ、おはよう翡翠。

“…Maybe I have a fever.” Perhaps it is yesterday’s alcohol, but my body feels leaden and faintly hot.
“Good morning, Master Shiki.” “Morning, Hisui. Did you sleep well last night?”
“Y-yes. I apologize for behaving so disgracefully yesterday.” “Oh, right—you fell asleep. Don’t worry about it. I passed out from anemia afterward, so I was much worse.”

　この時間は朝の部活をしていない生徒が登校してくる時間帯だ。

lines.maoEnglish:
Even walking slowly, I arrive ten minutes before the gates close. This is when students without morning practice usually come in. Since ours is an academically minded school, only the major sports clubs hold practice before class, so the gates naturally become a crush of arriving students.
“Oh, Ciel.” I spot her a short distance ahead, walking along in her brisk little way.

“Yeah, coming up on five years now. He’s been a lot of work from the day we met. I kept looking after him, and before I knew it, the poor guy had grown attached.” “…That account is seriously misleading. The accurate version is that you latched on to me and never let go.”
“Sure. Either way, we’re stuck with each other.” Arihiko laughed uproariously.

“Tohno!” The instant I stepped into the corridor, someone called my name.
“Thank goodness you’re still here. Were you about to leave?” “More or less. I’ve got nothing else to do, so I thought I’d be good and go straight home. Are you leaving too?” “Yes. No one needs me for anything today, so I thought I might do some shopping on the way.” “I see. Near the station?”
“No, what I want is sold right here.” Ciel had begun saying strange things again.

lines.japanese:
「痛っ――――」
　ズキリ、と首筋が痛んだ。
　貧血の前触れか、体も鉛のように重く感じる。
「……まずいな……部屋に戻らないと」
　頭を軽くふって、本当に倒れてしまう前に部屋に戻ることにした時。
「あら、志貴さんじゃないですか。
何をしているんですか、こんなところで」
　いきなり、琥珀さんが入ってきた。
lines.label: s336
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ow—”
Pain stabbed through the back of my neck.
Perhaps anemia was coming on; my body felt heavy as lead.
“This is bad… I need to get back to my room.”
I shook my head and decided to leave before I collapsed for real. Then—
“Why, Shiki. What are you doing in a place like this?”
Kohaku suddenly walked in.

「―――――っ！」
　ど、どうしようとあたりを見渡す。
　……隠れる場所なんてないし、そもそもとっくに見付かってしまっているじゃないか、俺。
「もう、ダメですよココに入っちゃ。
秋葉さまから志貴さんだけはここに入れてはいけないって言われてるんですから」
「……ああ、今日言われた。
言われたんだけど、その―――」
「気になってしまったんですね。
わかりました、今回だけは大目に見ますから、今後はココには来ないでください。
この屋敷、もともと古いものですからちょっと危ないんです」
lines.label: s336
lines.maoEnglish:
“—!”
I frantically looked around for some escape.
There was nowhere to hide, and in any case she had already found me. Brilliant, Shiki.
“You know you aren’t allowed in here. Miss Akiha gave us strict instructions that you, in particular, must never enter.”
“I know. She told me today. But, well…”
“You couldn’t help being curious, could you? Very well. I’ll overlook it this once, but please don’t come here again. This building is quite old, and parts of it are dangerous.”

……もともと古い建物だから危ない、か。
　なんかヘンな理由だけど、一応スジは通っている。
「……ごめん。
けど琥珀さん、ここっていったい何に使ってた建物なんだ？
　今は使ってないっていうけど、昔は使ってたのか？」
「ええ、ここはもともと使用人の住居だったんです。
志貴さんが有間の家に預けられる前まで、屋敷には十数人の使用人がおりました。
　それだけの数の人間をお屋敷のほうに住まわせる事はできなかったので、槙久さまがこの離れをお作りになられたんです」
「そう。
使用人の住居だったのか」
lines.label: s336
lines.maoEnglish:
The building was old and therefore dangerous.
It sounded odd, but it made a certain amount of sense.
“Sorry. But Kohaku, what was this building used for? Everyone says it’s abandoned now, so it must have been used for something before.”
“It was originally the servants’ residence. Until you were sent to live with the Arima family, more than a dozen servants worked at the mansion.
“There was no room for so many people in the main house, so your father had this annex built.”
“I see. So it was servants’ quarters.”

　だけど、どうして。
　秋葉は俺をここに入らせないようにしているんだろう―――？

An estate this large would naturally have needed something of the sort.
But then why—
Why was Akiha so determined to keep me out?

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Akiha says she will lose control if Shiki comes near now, then defiantly insists that she can manage even without him. mirrorMoonErrors.reason: The nightmare withholds the acting subject through subjectless Japanese and repeatedly frames Shiki as an uncertain observer; even the heat is said to affect 'the one watching.' The late detail of long hair helps destabilize whose experience this is. mirror moon inserts first-person subjects into the outing, hunt, mutilation, observer, and hair in all three recurrences, prematurely declaring every act and body Shiki's and damaging a central Akiha-route identity effect.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: The nightmare withholds the acting subject through subjectless Japanese and repeatedly frames Shiki as an uncertain observer; even the heat is said to affect 'the one watching.' The late detail of long hair helps destabilize whose experience this is. mirror moon inserts first-person subjects into the outing, hunt, mutilation, observer, and hair in all three recurrences, prematurely declaring every act and body Shiki's and damaging a central Akiha-route identity effect.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: The nightmare withholds the acting subject through subjectless Japanese and repeatedly frames Shiki as an uncertain observer; even the heat is said to affect 'the one watching.' The late detail of long hair helps destabilize whose experience this is. mirror moon inserts first-person subjects into the outing, hunt, mutilation, observer, and hair in all three recurrences, prematurely declaring every act and body Shiki's and damaging a central Akiha-route identity effect.
